sam: Quick UX/a11y note after today's design pass on /insights: keyboard-only users can't tell which row is selected in high-contrast mode, and screen readers say "graphic" for mini charts with no context. elaine: I saw that too. In Windows high-contrast the focus ring disappears entirely because the ring relies on box-shadow which HC strips. We need a fallback using outline or a visible border for forced color modes. noah: Repro: Win11 + High Contrast Black. Tab to table -> arrow keys move focus -> selected row has a 3px inset outline in normal mode, but HC overrides it and it becomes invisible. kevin: For charts, VoiceOver and NVDA read just "image" for the svg. We should give the svg a role="img" and an aria-labelledby pointing to a short title + desc. Example: ` but we added roving tabindex on rows. Screen readers announce rows as links sometimes. Maybe we should switch to role="grid" with gridcells so selection is announced as selected. Thoughts? elaine: Using native table with proper `aria-selected` on the row and `tabindex` management works fine if we don't change DOM on focus. Roving tabindex is fine but virtualization unmounts focused rows and NVDA loses focus. Suggest: when a row receives focus, set `aria-live="polite"` on a hidden announcer with text like "Row X selected, actions available" so users get stable feedback even if the DOM swaps. noah: Good idea. Sample announcer code: `
` then on focus announcer.textContent = "Selected row: Model prod-1, 95th percentile 1.2s". kevin: Tiny voice verbatim from NVDA I captured: "Row 3 of 12, link, Model prod-1" which is confusing because the row isn't a link. We should avoid making entire row a focusable anchor; instead make a single focusable button per row for primary action and use `aria-selected` on the row container to reflect selection state. sam: Action items: kevin -> paste NVDA/VoiceOver raw text into INF-4407, elaine -> propose CSS fallback for forced-colors and HC, noah -> add aria-labelledby/desc to charts and legend items, i'm going to prototype an announcer for virtualization edge cases. a11y-bot: Automated scan (2027-02-10): issues found on /insights: 1) forced-colors focus invisible, 2) svg missing accessible name, 3) element with tabindex=0 visually hidden. elaine: CSS suggestion for forced-colors: use `@media (forced-colors: active) { .row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid CanvasText; outline-offset: 2px; } }` That uses system colors so it stays visible in HC mode. Also add `:-ms-lang(x)` fallback for older IE if we care. noah: Legend accessibility: instead of just color swatches, render `
  • ` and ensure reading order equals visual order. If a legend item's color encodes meaning, include the color name in the label. kevin: For toasts: change non-critical toasts to `aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"`. Also ensure toasts aren't focusable, and don't steal focus during long tasks. sam: Logging ticket INF-4407 with repro steps, NVDA/VoiceOver snippets, screenshots in HC mode, and proposed CSS snippet. Linking this thread. elaine: One more nit: when keyboard navigating rows, using ArrowUp/Down should not trigger scroll-jump that re-virtualizes and steals focus. Add a short cooldown before virtualization unmounts a focused row. We can debounce the recycle for 200ms when `document.activeElement` is inside table. noah: Tests: I'll add Playwright checks for HC mode (emulate forced-colors) and for announcing selected rows via announcer. Example: `expect(await page.locator('#announcer').textContent()).toContain('Selected row');` kevin: Filed INF-4407 and assigned to eng-platform. Thx all. sam: Thanks team :thumbsup: Please flag me if any of the fixes affect mobile screen readers.
